assets.name: Character puppet
assets.description: The stick figure itself: head, torso, arms, legs and hands. Every person on screen is this puppet with a pose, a face and optional skin, hair and costume.
assets.use: <Character x groundY head pose face turn facing identity outfit prop />. A smaller head makes a child.

assets.name: Stand
assets.description: Standing still with the arms hanging at the sides. The default pose.

assets.name: Wave
assets.description: One arm raised in a wave, the other at the side.

assets.name: Point
assets.description: One arm stretched out with a pointing finger, leaning slightly forward.

assets.name: Shrug
assets.description: Both forearms raised to the sides and the head tilted, as in "I do not know".

assets.name: Hands up
assets.description: Both arms raised above the head, knees a little bent.

assets.name: Hold object
assets.description: One arm reaching out with a closed fist around an upright object such as a staff, the other arm relaxed.

assets.name: Hands over mouth
assets.description: Both hands pressed over the mouth in shock.

assets.name: Sit
assets.description: Sitting on a seat as high as the shins: thighs level, shins down, hands on the lap. Needs a seat, throne, rock or ledge under it.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(sit)} with a seat body.shin high under the hip; best three-quarter or profile

assets.name: Kneel
assets.description: Down on one knee with the other foot planted, a hand on the raised knee and the head bowed.

assets.name: Lie down
assets.description: Lying on the ground on one side with the head down, one arm along the body and one reaching forward.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(lie)} with turn={0}; the figure is about three heads long

assets.name: Cross arms
assets.description: Standing with both arms folded across the chest.

assets.name: Look up
assets.description: Standing with the head tipped back to look at something above.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(lookUp)} with lookAt on the thing above

assets.name: Look down
assets.description: Standing with the head bowed to look at something below.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(lookDown)} with lookAt on the thing below

assets.name: Cower
assets.description: Crouched and hunched with both arms raised over the head.

assets.name: Hug
assets.description: Leaning in with both arms wrapped around someone standing close in front. Two characters in this pose, facing each other, make a hug.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(hug)} on two characters about 1.2 head-widths apart, facing each other

assets.name: Walk
assets.description: A walking cycle with planted feet and swinging arms. The character moves forward as time passes.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}; the camera follows w.pose.rootX

assets.name: Proud walk
assets.description: A slow strut: chest out, chin up, high steps and a wide arm swing.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.proud); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Tired walk
assets.description: A slow trudge: short steps that barely leave the ground, bent forward with the head down and the arms hanging.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.tired); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Sneaky walk
assets.description: Creeping on high careful steps: crouched, head pushed forward, hands held up in front.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.sneaky); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Happy walk
assets.description: A quick bouncy walk with a big arm swing and the head up.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.happy); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Cheer
assets.description: Arms thrown up in a V and pumping, the body bouncing on bent knees. Loops.
assets.use: pose={cheerAt(frame / fps)} with the laughing or happy face

assets.name: Cry
assets.description: The face in both hands with the head bowed, shoulders shaking in bursts of sobs. Loops.
assets.use: pose={cryAt(frame / fps)} with the wailing or sad face

assets.name: Blinks and breathing
assets.description: Small movement while a character holds a pose: blinks every few seconds, breathing, a slight head bob and a slow shift of weight from leg to leg.
assets.use: pose={withLife(pose, frame, fps, seed)} blink={blinkAt(frame, fps, seed)}

assets.name: Talking mouth
assets.description: The mouth forms the spoken words of one voice line with five shapes: closed, half, open, wide (ee) and round (oo).
assets.use: talk={talkAt(frame, fps, wordsOfTheLine)} where the words are the voice track words of that line

assets.name: Pose changes with wind-up and settle
assets.description: Moving from one pose to the next: a short wind-up the other way before a big move, a quick snap, a small overshoot and a dip of the hips, then the hold.
assets.use: pose={poseAt(frame, [{ frame: 0, pose: stand }, { frame: 40, pose: wave }])}

assets.name: Capes, hair and held things swing
assets.description: Loose things lag behind the body: a cape or cloak hem and long hair trail a walk and swing on past when the body stops, and the top of a held staff tips back as the arm moves.
assets.use: sway={swayOf((f) => poseOfThisCharacterAt(f), frame, fps)} with the same function the scene uses for the pose

assets.name: Eye darts
assets.description: Small quick glances to the side every second or two, so the eyes are never frozen during a hold.

assets.name: Smooth head turn
assets.description: Turning to look the other way or toward a speaker: the head and body swing through the front view over a few frames instead of flipping.
assets.use: const t = turnAt(frame, [{ frame: 0, facing: "right", turn: 0.5 }, { frame: 60, facing: "left", turn: 0.5 }]); facing={t.facing} turn={t.turn}

assets.name: Neutral
assets.description: A calm, plain face. The default.

assets.name: Happy
assets.description: A smile with arched brows and lifted cheeks.

assets.name: Laughing
assets.description: Eyes closed in arcs and a wide open laughing mouth.

assets.name: Sad
assets.description: Raised inner brows, drooping lids, low pupils and a frown.

assets.name: Angry
assets.description: Hooked V brows, heavy shaded lids and a wide frown with curled corners.

assets.name: Shouting
assets.description: Angry brows with an open mouth showing teeth.

assets.name: Afraid
assets.description: The frightened face measured from Reference B: lower lids pushed up, pupils resting on them, worry creases and a wide gritted grimace. The face tips down toward where the character looks.

assets.name: Surprised
assets.description: High light brows, very wide eyes and a small round mouth.

assets.name: Determined
assets.description: Low straight brows, narrowed eyes and a firm mouth.

assets.name: Thinking
assets.description: One brow raised, pupils up and to the side, small sideways mouth.

assets.name: Smug
assets.description: One brow raised, half-closed lids and a one-sided smirk.

assets.name: Exhausted
assets.description: Drooping brows, heavy lids with a crease under each eye and a slack open mouth.

assets.name: Wailing
assets.description: Eyes squeezed shut with stress creases and a wide crying mouth with tongue.

assets.name: Horrified
assets.description: Very wide eyes with tiny pupils, light raised brows, a small round mouth and chin strokes.

assets.name: Stern eyes
assets.description: Black almond eyes under heavy brows, from the king in Reference A. For cold, commanding or menacing characters.

assets.name: Resting hand
assets.description: A rounded mitten with a small thumb bump, for hands that hang, rest or wave.
assets.use: hand: 'mitten' in a pose arm (the default)

assets.name: Gripping hand
assets.description: A closed fist around a handle: fingers as fat bands that hide the handle, thumb across the top.
assets.use: hand: 'grip', gripAxis: -90 in a pose arm

assets.name: Pointing hand
assets.description: A fist with the index finger extended.

assets.name: Skin tone 1
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 1 of 8, very light, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 2
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 2 of 8, light, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 3
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 3 of 8, light tan, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 4
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 4 of 8, tan, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 5
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 5 of 8, medium brown, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 6
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 6 of 8, brown, with its one shadow tone and a light rim so the face reads on dark backgrounds.

assets.name: Skin tone 7
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 7 of 8, dark brown, with its one shadow tone and a light rim so the face reads on dark backgrounds.

assets.name: Skin tone 8
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 8 of 8, very dark, with its one shadow tone and a light rim so the face reads on dark backgrounds.

assets.name: Bald
assets.description: No hair at all.

assets.name: Short crop
assets.description: Short hair close to the head.

assets.name: Fade
assets.description: Short on top with faded sides.

assets.name: Afro
assets.description: A big round afro.

assets.name: Locs
assets.description: Long locs hanging beside the face.

assets.name: Braids
assets.description: Long braids hanging beside the face.

assets.name: Straight bob
assets.description: Straight hair cut at the jaw.

assets.name: Bun
assets.description: Hair tied in a bun on top of the head.

assets.name: Ponytail
assets.description: Hair tied back in a ponytail.

assets.name: Head wrap
assets.description: A cloth wrap covering the hair, in an accent color.

assets.name: Long hair
assets.description: Long hair falling down the back, behind the shoulders.

assets.name: Black hair
assets.description: Black hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Dark brown hair
assets.description: Dark brown hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Brown hair
assets.description: Brown hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Auburn hair
assets.description: Auburn hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Blond hair
assets.description: Blond hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Gray hair
assets.description: Gray hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: White hair
assets.description: White hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Beard
assets.description: A full beard along the jaw, in the hair color.

assets.name: Moustache
assets.description: A moustache above the mouth, in the hair color.

assets.name: Tank top
assets.description: A sleeveless top with narrow straps, as on the frightened figure in Reference B. Arms stay stick lines.

assets.name: Shirt
assets.description: A plain buttoned shirt with long or short sleeves, in any cloth color.

assets.name: Trousers
assets.description: Long trousers with legs hanging from the hips, as the navy jeans in Reference B.

assets.name: Skirt
assets.description: A knee-length skirt flaring from the waist, with stick legs below.

assets.name: Dress
assets.description: A knee-length dress: a fitted top that flares from the waist.

assets.name: Robe
assets.description: A long robe from the shoulders to the ankles with wide sleeves and a cord at the waist.

assets.name: Cloak
assets.description: A cloak down the back with a drape over each shoulder, worn over other clothes. The hood lies behind the neck.

assets.name: Hood
assets.description: The cloak with its hood pulled up, framing the face.

assets.name: Brimmed hat
assets.description: A plain hat with a wide flat brim, like a straw hat. It sits just above the brows.

assets.name: Sneakers
assets.description: Low chunky shoes with a round toe cap, a sole stripe and laces, as in Reference B.

assets.name: Boots
assets.description: Chunky ankle boots in any cloth color.

assets.name: Ruler
assets.description: A full royal costume: three-point gold crown, crimson cape with a high collar, steel breastplate, sleeves and boots with gold trim, white gloves. An original design in the spirit of Reference A.

assets.name: Soldier
assets.description: A foot soldier in full costume: a pointed steel helmet with a gold band over a mail coif, a crimson tabard with a gold belt, steel shoulder plates, mail sleeves and leggings, boots. An original design.

assets.name: Queen
assets.description: A queen or noblewoman in full costume: a navy gown to the ground with gold belt and hem, short puffed sleeves, white gloves and a low gold crown of three arches with pearls. An original design.

assets.name: Farmer
assets.description: A farmer or villager: green short-sleeved shirt, navy trousers, plain boots and a straw hat. Built from the tier 1 garments.

assets.name: Child
assets.description: A child: a smaller body under a full-size head. Use a smaller head size than the adults in the shot as well.
assets.use: age="child" on the Character, with head about 0.86 of an adult's

assets.name: Adult
assets.description: An adult: the standard proportions. This is the default.

assets.name: Elder
assets.description: An elder: a stooped back and a few permanent creases on the face. Add gray or white hair and a beard for the rest.
assets.use: age="elder" on the Character, with gray or white hair

assets.name: Scepter
assets.description: A gold scepter with a crimson orb, held upright in a gripping hand.
assets.use: prop={(hands, info) => <Scepter frame={hands.front} uid={info.uid} shadowSide={info.shadowSide} />} with the hold-object pose

assets.name: Flying sweat drops
assets.description: Light blue drops that fly out from the head in arcs and fade, on a loop. For fear, panic and strain.

assets.name: Resting sweat drop
assets.description: One light blue drop sitting on the head. For worry, effort and tiredness.

assets.name: Simple background
assets.description: Flat color fields, a flat ground band and black silhouettes, from Reference B. For comedy, everyday scenes and fast explainers.
assets.use: <Background spec={backgroundSpec('simple', palette, seed, overrides)} width height frame fps />

assets.name: Atmospheric background
assets.description: A soft painted sky with layered clouds, light rays, stars, haze and hills, from Reference A. For drama, history, danger and emotional peaks.
assets.use: <Background spec={backgroundSpec('atmospheric', palette, seed, overrides)} width height frame fps />

assets.name: Storm slate
assets.description: Dark blue-gray night colors, from Reference A.

assets.name: Dusk violet
assets.description: Muted violet night colors, from Reference B.

assets.name: Clear day
assets.description: Blue sky and green ground for daytime.

assets.name: Warm interior
assets.description: Warm tan and brown colors for indoor scenes.

assets.name: Danger
assets.description: Dark reds for threat, fire and battle.

assets.name: Cold dawn
assets.description: Pale blue-gray and cream for early morning.

assets.name: Crescent moon
assets.description: A flat pale yellow crescent moon with no outline. It stays put while other layers slide.
assets.use: moon: { x, y, r } in the background spec; null hides it

assets.name: Stars
assets.description: A few small white dots of varied size that twinkle.

assets.name: Clouds
assets.description: Soft layered clouds that drift slowly, lighter on the edge facing the light.
assets.use: clouds: <count> in an atmospheric background spec

assets.name: Light rays
assets.description: Two to four pale translucent beams from the light source, pulsing gently.
assets.use: rays: true in an atmospheric background spec

assets.name: Hills
assets.description: Soft distant hills on the horizon, lighter the farther away.
assets.use: hills: true in the background spec

assets.name: Grass tufts
assets.description: Small dark tufts of grass on the ground.

assets.name: Bush
assets.description: A black bush with white curl details, like the one in Reference B.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'bush', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Tree
assets.description: A round-topped tree silhouette.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'tree', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Rock
assets.description: A dark rock or boulder silhouette.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'rock', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Buildings
assets.description: A row of plain building silhouettes.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'buildings', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Gold
assets.description: The gold accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Crimson
assets.description: The crimson accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Orange
assets.description: The orange accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Steel
assets.description: The steel accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Denim
assets.description: The denim accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Glint
assets.description: The glint accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Forest
assets.description: The forest accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Slow push-in
assets.description: The camera moves slowly closer to a focus point over a shot. For emotional lines.
assets.use: <PushIn frame durationInFrames strength={0.08} focus={{ x, y }}>...</PushIn>

assets.name: Captions
assets.description: White Fredoka captions with a black outline in the bottom quarter, two short lines at a time, the emphasized word in gold.
